cuts.item: Athletic Trainer (full-time position), replaced with contracted EMT coverage at required events only
Athletic Director, reduced from full-time to part-time (as a trade-off to keep the full-time trainer)
School custodians / grounds staff, outsourced to a private contractor

statements.statement: Chair says he mistakenly double-counted $500,000 in free cash when calculating the deficit
Chair says he also incorrectly factored in about $19,000 in anticipated trim (transportation) costs
Chair announces the corrected, lower anticipated deficit figure (as captioned, apparently truncated)
A member recalls the original reported budget deficit was $2.4 million
The deficit figure was corrected down to about $1.9 million
Committee has not yet submitted a number for a potential override or put anything on the town meeting warrant
Member states the level-service shortfall is about 900, and asks whether that figure includes new growth and the town manager's budget
Correcting an overbudgeted high school principal/assistant principal salary line results in a $72,695 savings in the FY27 projection
Member states the district has to cut $900,000 from the budget absent an override
Restoration-budget override gap is measured against what the town manager is expected to provide based on 2.5% growth plus new growth
Committee's target is to get the restoration-budget override ask to under $2 million
Current restoration-budget override figure sits at about $1.9 million
Restoring the original athletic structure (full-time AD plus full-time athletic trainer) would add $42,886 to the budget
At the $1.9 million override ask, the school's share of the town budget split works out to about 57%
The town manager would prefer the school's share of the budget split be at about 53%
